g.text: DETERMINISTIC SPINE: rules over recorded evidence govern claims, actions and release.
SOURCE REACH (C-G1.6): each source has a materiality rating, a sensitivity rating and one information plane. Missing allocation fails configuration.

text.tspan: A person approves each semantic claim before it enters L0.
Contradictions wait for review. Derived views rebuild from recorded sources.
survivorship verdicts · lineage stamps · oversight verdicts
release and refusal records · observation serving status

g.text: OPERATIONAL VIEWS: live queries or declared projections. Each projection carries a build stamp, reconciliation result, source path and freshness state. Recall reads the knowledge plane.

text.tspan: selects allowed evidence surfaces for the request
recall · observations · live federation · consolidated insight · governed ad-hoc read
A model can propose a route. Rules check the proposal against the allow-list.
selects a reasoning tier after evidence assembly
handles novel and broad tasks through
A task-keyed journal stores nested intent and result units. Intent is saved before
an effect. The result is saved before emission, acknowledgement or offset advance.
Approval waits and effect settlement records survive process loss. Recovery uses
the effect class. An uncertain non-idempotent outcome goes to reconciliation.

g.text: RELEASE INPUTS: each service supplies its own recorded verdict

text.tspan: The single external egress path over the answer-surface registry. It classifies each
registered surface protected or unprotected, defaults an absent or unrecognised
classification to protected-and-refused, consumes the named verdicts atomically, and
persists its own authoritative release-or-refusal record before any byte is emitted.
